periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; vertical axis is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward taper with the lower boundary extending well below the horizontal center of the orbit.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation; the gap between the medial ear margins is roughly 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly rounded and smooth semicircular curvature at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-tan discoloration/staining visible on the white ventral fur of the chest and abdomen.
